author: TeIq
content: Delivered: FirehoseWorker struct with bounded mpsc outbound channel, tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken shutdown with cursor-flush-before-exit, tokio::sync::watch-free single-task cursor ownership pattern, tokio::time::interval flush every N events OR T seconds (configurable), reconnect on clean upstream close rebuilding Firehose with current cursor. FirehoseConfig + FirehoseError + NormalizedEvent types. Migration 00000000000002_firehose_cursor.sql with single-row UPSERT pattern + monotonic seq guard. Integration test firehose_cursor_persistence.rs proves cursor read+upsert round-trip under testcontainers Postgres 16. .sqlx/ cache grew from 10 to 12 with the two new firehose query metadata files.
